title: verbascum eriorrhabdon var. balansae
intro: Verbascum eriorrhabdon var. balansae, commonly known as Balansa mullein, is a flowering plant species in the figwort family. Balansa mullein is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe wounds and reduce inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, making it potentially useful in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Balansa mullein include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
